d.ko: Start with a spoon and a dream. Dig for treasures, unlock upgrades, get help from friendly pals and flip tools to dig up mountains of dirt. Will you find out what secrets are hidden beneath the dirt?
d.en: Start with a spoon and a dream. Dig for treasures, unlock upgrades, get help from friendly pals and flip tools to dig up mountains of dirt. Will you find out what secrets are hidden beneath the dirt?
d.zh: 从一把勺子和一个梦想起步。挖掘宝藏，解锁升级，雇佣可爱的帮手，发掘深埋地下的秘密。
